name: TWiLight Menu++ / nds-bootstrap (3DS)
location: <ROM folder>/saves/ by default; next to the ROM or sd:/_nds/TWiLightMenu/saves/ depending on SAVE_LOCATION in sd:/_nds/TWiLightMenu/settings.ini; .sav1 to .sav9 for the per-game save slot (SAVE_NUMBER)
notes: Raw save data. At launch TWiLight Menu++ (title/arm9/source/main.cpp) creates the file or grows it to the size of its own ROM list (512 KiB for unknown games), filling with 0x00, and never shrinks it: the save is written at its real size and TWiLight Menu++ pads it. nds-bootstrap then writes the save sectors in place (retail/common/source/my_fat.c, fileWrite) without updating the FAT directory entry, so the file's modification date does not change while playing. Stays to_verify until a real round trip on a 3DS.
